description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer, which provides methods for rendering HTML elements, generating HTML tags, and formatting output, primarily for debugging or presentation purposes within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer
classes.description: A class for rendering HTML elements and debugging output within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: prepareGenerator
methods.description: Prepares the generator object with the provided configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns an HTML start tag with optional attributes.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns a complete HTML element with content, with optional escaping.

methods.name: row
methods.description: Creates an HTML table row with a key/value pair.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe HTML output.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts a list of strings into a comma-separated list, optionally polite with 'and'.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class name and metadata of an object, removing prefixes.
